hook: San Francisco banned back rent evictions under one month's threshold.

sections.voiceover: San Francisco banned back rent evictions under one month's threshold.
Mayor Daniel Lurie signed file number 260962 on October 29, 2026. Hidden fees add 10 to 30 percent to monthly costs. Why did San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie sign new legislation protecting renters?
The Board of Supervisors voted unanimously on October 20, 2026, to require upfront fee disclosures.
Renters are protected from eviction under 1 month of unpaid rent. Landlords must disclose total costs. Urban Institute Initiative data reveals massive hidden fees.
File number 260962 stops unwarranted evictions across San Francisco.
